documents.text: Our consulting operations team struggles with unclear ownership. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The account is currently in the 'qualified' stage with a score of 80, indicating a strong fit and intent. The customer has expressed interest in workflow coordination and account reporting, and has requested a discovery meeting to clarify integration requirements. The customer has not yet approved a budget, but has given consent for Cedar Systems to proceed.

raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to Cedar Systems. We're pleased to learn of your interest in our workflow coordination and account reporting solutions. As requested, we would be happy to schedule a discovery meeting to better understand your specific integration requirements and how we can best support your operations.

Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we will make the necessary arrangements.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Sales Team
[Contact Information]
questions: When would be a convenient time for a discovery meeting?
Are there any specific departments or stakeholders you'd like to include in the meeting?
uncertainties: The customer has not yet approved a budget, which may impact the timeline or scope of the project.
The exact integration requirements are still to be determined during the discovery meeting.
